Daily ShipStation awaiting-shipment and: Daily ShipStation awaiting-shipment and on-hold orders. Age is elapsed time since the order date; groups include both statuses. These are observations during a scan, not end-of-day totals or dispatch counts.
Collected once daily after 07:00 store t: Collected once daily after 07:00 store time for stores with scheduled audits enabled. Missing days are unknown, not zero. Weekly changes compare only with an observation exactly seven days earlier. No historical backfill is inferred.
No backlog observations for this period.
Control each report independently. Pausi: Control each report independently. Pausing stops future and queued automatic runs; a running report can finish. Run now also works while paused.
For another report, run it with your des: For another report, run it with your desired filters and choose Schedule with these filters from its results. Complete reports without pagination cursors can be scheduled. A scheduler and queue worker must be running.
Report execution failed. Check run histo: Report execution failed. Check run history.
A Run Audit schedule replaces this store: A Run Audit schedule replaces this store’s legacy daily audit automation, including when the new schedule is paused.
Backlog history preserves the first succ: Backlog history preserves the first successful observation of each store-local day. Running it again on that day reuses the observation.
End period this many days ago: End period this many days ago
The date range moves at each execution. An end offset of 1 ends yesterday; 0 includes today.
Email only when findings meet the thresh: Email only when findings meet the threshold
The report could not be queued. Check in: The report could not be queued. Check integrations and queue health.
This schedule already has a queued or ru: This schedule already has a queued or running report.
Choose a complete supported report run w: Choose a complete supported report run without a pagination cursor.
Run a report with the desired filters, t: Run a report with the desired filters, then choose Schedule with these filters.
Collection is controlled independently i: Collection is controlled independently in Report schedules. The first successful observation of each store-local day is preserved. Missing days are unknown, not zero. Weekly changes require an observation exactly seven days earlier.
An Operational Digest schedule replaces: An Operational Digest schedule replaces automatic digest generation from Email Rules, including while paused.
Inspect imported charges and credits, tr: Inspect imported charges and credits, track disputes and reconcile explicitly expected label refunds.
Imported postings are an observed cost b: Imported postings are an observed cost basis, not proof of a final or complete invoice. Amounts in different currencies are never combined. A dispute decision does not count as received money.
Imports belong to the active store and c: Imports belong to the active store and current ShipStation credential set. After changing accounts or credentials, old imports remain stored but are not matched automatically.
Map your statement to the template; raw: Map your statement to the template; raw carrier exports may use different columns. Use a stable source account reference across overlapping statements. All rows must use the active ShipStation store number and exact shipment/order IDs. One row represents one posted transaction.
Select posting dates. Totals include all: Select posting dates. Totals include all imported postings through the end date for labels appearing in the selection. SKU sets are grouped together; costs are not allocated or counted once per individual SKU.
The selection is incomplete. Narrow the: The selection is incomplete. Narrow the date range; no complete billing reconciliation is implied.
No imported billing in this period.
Review before importing. Amounts are non: Review before importing. Amounts are nonnegative; transaction type determines debit or credit. Existing identical transactions are skipped; conflicting IDs reject the entire import. No carrier or order is changed.
First 20 rows are shown. Confirm imports: First 20 rows are shown. Confirm imports the whole validated file. Preview expires after 10 minutes.
Configure the ShipStation account and st: Configure the ShipStation account and store number before importing billing.
CSV columns must match the billing templ: CSV columns must match the billing template exactly.
Use at most 5000 complete rows with exac: Use at most 5000 complete rows with exactly the template columns.
The order reference must not be empty.
The billing file contains no transaction: The billing file contains no transactions.
A transaction ID already exists with dif: A transaction ID already exists with different data. No rows were imported.
Import preview expired. Upload the file: Import preview expired. Upload the file again.
The account changed after preview. Uploa: The account changed after preview. Upload the file again.
Set an expected refund only for an unamb: Set an expected refund only for an unambiguous single label charge.
Billing review saved. Dispute decisions: Billing review saved. Dispute decisions do not confirm received credits.
Narrow the selection to at most 5000 tra: Narrow the selection to at most 5000 transactions before exporting.
The original contribution uses reported: The original contribution uses reported label costs. Imported billing is a separate observed basis, including imported charges and credits only. Neither basis is accounting net profit or proof of complete carrier billing.
Customer shipping charges are counted on: Customer shipping charges are counted once per order across the selected labels. Imported billing is used only when all selected labels have matching order and currency coverage. Other shipments and unimported postings may be missing; this is not a final invoice.
Voiding does not prove payment or a refu: Voiding does not prove payment or a refund. Only imported label-refund transactions count as received; refund expectations and due dates are set explicitly in Shipping Billing Audit.
Run reports again after importing. Saved: Run reports again after importing. Saved results retain their original snapshot.
Combine explicitly mapped SKU codes in F: Combine explicitly mapped SKU codes in Fulfilled Items, Returned Items and Inventory Forecast.
Mappings are case-sensitive and one-to-o: Mappings are case-sensitive and one-to-one in units. Do not map bundles or multipacks to individual units. Inventory forecasts require one unambiguous master variant; conflicting stock is excluded and flagged. Saved reports keep their original results.
Enable SKU aliases for new reports: Enable SKU aliases for new reports
Clear both fields to remove a mapping. S: Clear both fields to remove a mapping. Save to get five additional empty rows. Maximum 200 mappings per store.
Each alias must be unique and different: Each alias must be unique and different from its master SKU.
A master SKU cannot also be an alias. Us: A master SKU cannot also be an alias. Use direct mappings without chains or cycles.
Forecast excluded mapped SKUs with missi: Forecast excluded mapped SKUs with missing or ambiguous master inventory:
Explicit SKU aliases were applied. Unmap: Explicit SKU aliases were applied. Unmapped codes remain separate; items without a SKU retain their product label.
Observed remaining Shopify fulfillment q: Observed remaining Shopify fulfillment quantities and estimated merchandise value by currency
Remaining physical-shipping units from v: Remaining physical-shipping units from visible Shopify fulfillment orders, including partial, held and scheduled work. Cancelled, closed and test work is excluded.
Coverage follows the integration’s grant: Coverage follows the integration’s granted access scopes; inaccessible work and older orders may be absent. Values are estimates from remaining units × Shopify’s approximate discounted unit price in the order currency. Shipping fees are excluded; tax inclusion follows the source price. These are not receivables, dispatch counts or revenue.
The first successful daily observation i: The first successful daily observation is preserved. Missing or incomplete reads never become zero. Weekly quantity comparisons require the same account, access scopes and timezone exactly seven days earlier.
No Shopify backlog observations for this: No Shopify backlog observations for this period.
Optional separate V2 key for manual move: Optional separate V2 key for manual movement checks. Requires tracking API access. Leave blank to keep the key. Checks may count against your API plan.
Manual carrier tracking checks for accep: Manual carrier tracking checks for acceptance, stalled progress and exceptions
Check one order using current carrier tr: Check one order using current carrier tracking. This runs only when requested.
Configure ShipStation V1 credentials, it: Configure ShipStation V1 credentials, its store number and a separate V2 tracking API key for this store.
The movement check could not be complete: The movement check could not be completed. Verify tracking API access and shipment identity.
Checks up to ten labels for one verified: Checks up to ten labels for one verified store order. Tracking reads may count against your API plan. Findings appear in Delivery exceptions for ownership and claim review dates.
Label creation is not carrier handover. No acceptance record means the carrier currently reports Not Yet In System. Unknown statuses or missing event times remain unknown; they do not resolve existing issues.
Set the due date from the actual carrier: Set the due date from the actual carrier claim policy. No deadline is inferred automatically.
Automatic checks are controlled separate: Automatic checks are controlled separately in Report schedules. The UTC daily cap counts manual and automatic tracking attempts, including failed requests. Zero disables all new tracking reads.
I verified tracking access, selected car: I verified tracking access, selected carrier coverage and API costs for this key.
Changing ShipStation credentials or stor: Changing ShipStation credentials or store identity resets this verification. Save the key first, verify it, then confirm here.
Measured Shopify order creations and rec: Measured Shopify order creations and recorded carrier acceptance events, with explicit coverage
Two measured event streams for completed: Two measured event streams for completed store-local days.
Created orders use Shopify creation time: Created orders use Shopify creation timestamps, exclude test orders and include later cancellations and digital orders. Carrier counts use dated AC acceptance events recorded from checked labels only. They are not all dispatches, and these two cohorts must not be subtracted to reconstruct backlog.
A blank carrier count means no tracking: A blank carrier count means no tracking observations exist for this account. Zero means no acceptance event is recorded in the observed subset, not zero actual dispatches. Older order ranges require full Shopify order-history access.
Choose completed store-local days, up to: Choose completed store-local days, up to 366 days per report.
Shipment activity requires completed sto: Shipment activity requires completed store-local days.
Bounded tracking cohort checks with veri: Bounded tracking cohort checks with verified access, shared UTC daily budget and fair rotation
Bounded checks of recent labels, with ol: Bounded checks of recent labels, with oldest observations checked first.
Verify the V2 tracking key, carrier cove: Verify the V2 tracking key, carrier coverage and API costs in Store settings before monitoring.
Monitoring could not complete. Check acc: Monitoring could not complete. Check access, the UTC daily cap and the selected shipment cohort.
Limits and allowed carriers are configur: Limits and allowed carriers are configured per store. Manual and automatic checks share the UTC daily read cap. Failed API attempts consume the cap. Missing labels or unknown tracking evidence never resolve issues.
Only part of the eligible cohort was che: Only part of the eligible cohort was checked within the configured limits. This is not a complete store-wide delivery report.
No eligible tracking labels were checked: No eligible tracking labels were checked.
The store’s daily tracking-read limit ha: The store’s daily tracking-read limit has been reached (UTC).
Sign out and sign in with Google again t: Sign out and sign in with Google again to manage two-factor authentication.
